newsitem.title: HONG KONG: South China steps up fight against corruption - paper.
newsitem.headline: South China steps up fight against corruption - paper.

text.p: Authorities in southern China has ordered senior cadres to declare their interests in a bid to stem out corruption, a Hong Kong newspaper said on Thursday.

The Apple Daily newspaper said senior officials from southern city of Shenzhen, just across the border from the British colony of Hong Kong, were told to declare their annual income, financial situation and gifts beginning in April.
About 500 cadres in the southern boom town would be affected under the new directive, the newspaper said.
Corruption, virtually eliminated in the years after the communists came to power in 1949, has returned in the last two decades in the wake of economic reforms.
